messages:
anna: Heads up — noticed the p99 on the /v1/endpoint-latency dashboard jumped ~300ms at 11:12 UTC after the quota fallback tweak. Link: https://console/redwood/dash/endpoint-latency :eyes:
leo: saw that too. looks like the fallback moved a lot of traffic to the edge variant. are we sure the dashboard p99 is measuring the same thing (processing vs total)?
maria: good call. console recently added the `derive-percentiles-from` toggle (processing_time | total_time). I think the default flipped for endpoints with quota fallbacks last week.
anna: ah, that explains a lot. the spike aligns with the rollout. can we quickly validate whether the p50/p95/p99 lines are mixing origins?
oliver: tl;dr — our rollup pipeline stores tdigest of the raw latencies but the UI aggregates percentiles across rollups without preserving origin metadata. so if route A used `processing_time` and route B used `total_time` after fallback, the blended p99 is meaningless.
jules: we should add provenance per-percentile, not just per-rollup. proposal: telemetry API returns an array like:
```json
{"quantiles": [0.5,0.95,0.99], "values": [120, 220, 520], "origins": ["processing_time","processing_time","total_time"], "sample_counts": [1200, 900, 80]}
```
so the UI can show a little badge: "p99 (total_time, n=80)" instead of silently blending.
leo: love that. even a tooltip would reduce a ton of guesswork. small UX ask: show origin + sample_count + route-breakdown on hover.
maria: quick mitigation: for this rollout I can make the console annotate the legend when the dominant origin != route origin. i.e., show an asterisk if derivation methods differ across merged rollups. low effort and helps on-call.
anna: sounds good. do we have tests to catch cross-origin percentile flips during canaries? this was very confusing for SRE pager.
oliver: we don't. unit tests operate on identical derivation. adding a synthetic test that merges rollups with mixed `derive-percentiles-from` would catch regressions. I'll add one in the rollup-suite.
jules: longer term we should extend the telemetry contract. two concrete tasks: 1) API: include `per_quantile_origin` + `sample_counts` (backwards compatible; optional fields) 2) UI: tooltip + legend badge + route breakdown.
dashboard-bot: created issue #INFR-1423: "percentile provenance + sample_count in telemetry + console annotations" assigned to oliver/jules/maria.
anna: thanks. for the immediate on-call please annotate the p99 line with a red asterisk and a hover text: "mixed derivation detected — values may not be comparable across routes". maria, can you do that before 12:30 UTC?
maria: yep, patching now. will comment the PR link when up. :thumbsup:
leo: after this we should run a short audit across top-50 endpoints to flag any that have >10% of p99 derived from a different origin than p95. that will surface other silent spikes.
anna: agreed. assign it to the telemetry triage board. thanks team.
